description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent in the namespace OrangeHRM\Pim\Event. The class represents an event triggered when an employee's joined date changes, encapsulating the employee object and the previous joined date.

classes.name: EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent
classes.description: Represents an event that occurs when an employee's joined date changes, containing the employee object and prior joined date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the employee object and previous joined date.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with the event.

methods.name: getPreviousJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the previous joined date before the change, or null if not available.
